answer: Because the pulse stake is held until the spiral settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the basalt audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 39% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A farm running 100 keys therefore forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
